notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 unnamed federation join overload. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that two independent unnamed joins receive distinct non-empty generated federate names, each name reverses to its corresponding handle, both names and a named member appear in the federation member report, and standard resignation/destruction cleanup succeeds. Focused installed-package MinGW/Ninja CTest and direct runner checks passed under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE on 2026-10-16; result artifact: out/mgw/tck-restore-single-positive-20261016/unnamed-join-unique-recheck.json. This remains experimental API evidence, not conformance evidence, and asserts no provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador unnamed and named joinFederationExecution overloads with federate lookup, member reporting, resignation, and federation destruction services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador federation membership and lookup declarations
